enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Sleep. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Move arm. Move leg. Sleep. Snore. Breathe. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and getting out of bed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Yawn. Stretch arms. Sit up on bed. Rub eyes. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.
Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Rub hands with soap. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

Pour milk into glass. Place bread in toaster. Toast bread. Spread butter on toast. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Place dishes in sink. Wash dishes.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to locker. Put on uniform. Walk to station.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Remove shoes. Hang up coat.

Enter living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Return to living room. Sit down. Drink. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Enter living room. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Pick up book. Read book. Look at TV. Change channel. Read book. Adjust lamp. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return. Sit down. Eat snack. Read book. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Enter bedroom. Turn on lamp. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Read book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Turn off lamp. Lie down.
